sources.extracted_facts: Cottonworld is an Indian natural-clothing brand. Its voice is calm, warm, plain and life-first. Clothing supports daily life; practical intention, repeat wear and fewer unnecessary choices are relevant themes. Avoid unsupported fabric-performance, environmental, product or ranking claims.

Live India SERP for the proposed title had no exact-title result. Three relevant organic blogs were reviewed: Angharad Jones Best (1,606 extracted words; personal weather situation to tips and outfits), Love Olive Co (1,934; item-by-item outfit guide with frequent product calls to action), and 40+style (3,408; detailed fabric/proportion advice followed by clothing-category examples and shopping content). Counts include some page furniture. The new outline uses comparable practical depth with a life-first opening, fabric/fit guidance, three daily-routine outfit examples, a wardrobe-use section and FAQs, without copying the competitors' wording or structure.

The extension page states cotton allows air to circulate and lists linen among summer fabric choices. The draft attributes this narrow point to the source and notes that garment weight, weave, fit and weather also matter.
